newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate eases down after FOMC ruling.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate eases down after FOMC ruling.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates closed down 40 basis points on Wednesday to 18.00 percent in a continuing reaction to the Federal Open Market Committee decision not to raise U.S. interest rates, traders said.
"The market is quiet and very stable, it was firm all day," a dealer said.
Overnight rates on bank paper ended down 30 basis points at 19.00 percent.
Cetes June futures contracts meanwhile ended up 10 centavos at 78.90 pesos.
Banco de Mexico drained 809 million pesos from the system through three direct Cetes sales and two repos.
Liquidity of 10.857 billion pesos was due to return to the market on Thursday from prior central bank participation.
